{"program":"domain(person,[santiago,sam,shmoopie,gracie]).
% If Santiago either designs infrastructure or connects isolated areas (but not both), then he builds bridges.
axiom(s1, rule([xor(designs_infrastructure(santiago), connects_isolated_areas(santiago))], builds_bridges(santiago))).
% If someone volunteers, then they strengthen social bonds.
axiom(s2, rule([volunteers(X)], strengthens_social_bonds(X))).
% Sam empowers local residents.
axiom(s3, empowers_local_residents(sam)).
% If Sam improves lives, then he either enhances public services or unites communities (or both).
axiom(s4, rule([improves_lives(sam)], or(enhances_public_services(sam), unites_communities(sam)))).
% If Sam builds bridges, then he can either foster economic growth or unite communities, but not both.
axiom(s5, rule([builds_bridges(sam)], xor(fosters_economic_growth(sam), unites_communities(sam)))).
% Sam has engineering skills.
axiom(s6, has_engineering_skills(sam)).
% If Sam cares about others, then he connects isolated areas and strives for innovation.
axiom(s7, rule([cares_about_others(sam)], and(connects_isolated_areas(sam), strives_for_innovation(sam)))).
% Sam strives for innovation.
axiom(s8, strives_for_innovation(sam)).
% Sam cares about others.
axiom(s9, cares_about_others(sam)).
% If Sam values his community, then he will connect isolated areas.
axiom(s10, rule([values_community(sam)], connects_isolated_areas(sam))).
% If Sam overcomes obstacles, then he either unites communities or strengthens social bonds (or both).
axiom(s11, rule([overcomes_obstacles(sam)], or(unites_communities(sam), strengthens_social_bonds(sam)))).
% Sam either has engineering skills or designs infrastructure, but not both.
axiom(s12, xor(has_engineering_skills(sam), designs_infrastructure(sam))).
% Shmoopie succeeds in projects.
axiom(s13, succeeds_in_projects(shmoopie)).
% Gracie has engineering skills.
axiom(s14, has_engineering_skills(gracie)).
% If Sam either designs infrastructure or connects isolated areas (but not both), then he builds bridges.
axiom(s15, rule([xor(designs_infrastructure(sam), connects_isolated_areas(sam))], builds_bridges(sam))).
% Santiago empowers local residents.
axiom(s16, empowers_local_residents(santiago)).
% If Gracie builds bridges, then he can either foster economic growth or unite communities, but not both.
axiom(s17, rule([builds_bridges(gracie)], xor(fosters_economic_growth(gracie), unites_communities(gracie)))).
% If Sam succeeds in projects, then he either strengthens social bonds or empowers local residents, but not both.
axiom(s18, rule([succeeds_in_projects(sam)], xor(strengthens_social_bonds(sam), empowers_local_residents(sam)))).
% If Gracie cares about others, then he connects isolated areas and strives for innovation.
axiom(s19, rule([cares_about_others(gracie)], and(connects_isolated_areas(gracie), strives_for_innovation(gracie)))).
% Sam overcomes obstacles.
axiom(s20, overcomes_obstacles(sam)).
% Santiago cares about others.
axiom(s21, cares_about_others(santiago)).
% Sam succeeds in projects.
axiom(s22, succeeds_in_projects(sam)).","query":"labelled_explanation(fosters_economic_growth(sam), Status, Package)"}
